meta.name: paper-context-resolver
meta.description: Rigor Paper Context helper for README-first deep learning repo reproduction. Use only when the README and repository files leave a narrow reproduction-critical gap and the task is to resolve a specific paper detail such as dataset split, preprocessing, evaluation protocol, checkpoint mapping, or runtime assumption from primary paper sources while recording conflicts. Do not use for general paper summary, repo scanning, environment setup, command execution, title-only paper lookup, or replacing README guidance by default.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从论文原文补全复现缺失的细节
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果论文代码的README缺少关键细节，需要从原文查证。
copy.tagline_en: Resolve missing reproduction details from paper sources
copy.fit_line_en: For you if the README lacks critical details for reproducing a paper and you need to consult the original source.

howto.what: 当复现深度学习论文时，如果README和仓库文件缺少关键细节（如数据集划分、预处理、评估协议等），这个技能会从原始论文中查找并给出精确答案，同时记录与README的矛盾。
howto.when: 当README和仓库文件留下一个狭窄的复现关键缺口，且需要解决具体的论文细节（如数据集划分、预处理、评估协议、检查点映射或运行时假设）时触发。

say.text: 这篇论文的测试集划分在README里没写，帮我从论文原文里查一下。
say.note: 技能会从论文中提取数据集划分信息。

say.text: README说用top-1准确率，但论文里用的是top-5，请确认并记录冲突。
say.note: 技能会对比论文和README，指出矛盾。

howto.what_en: When reproducing a deep learning paper, if the README and repo files lack critical details (e.g., dataset split, preprocessing, evaluation protocol), this skill retrieves precise answers from the original paper and records conflicts with the README.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the README and repo files leave a narrow reproduction-critical gap and the task is to resolve a specific paper detail such as dataset split, preprocessing, evaluation protocol, checkpoint mapping, or runtime assumption.

say_en.text: The test split is missing in the README. Please look it up from the paper.
say_en.note: The skill extracts dataset split info from the paper.

say_en.text: README says top-1 accuracy but the paper uses top-5. Confirm and log the conflict.
say_en.note: The skill compares paper and README, noting discrepancies.
